text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:

-Conservative party leader Jan Petersen criticises Foreign Minister Bjoern Tore Godal for not joining other NATO countries in voting against a U.N. proposal to eliminate nuclear weapons. Norway abstained in the vote.

-Norway's biggest shipping company Bergesen still faces problems in the tanker market. For the third quarter Bergesen posted losses, but still the company expect that 1996 operating profits as a whole will show an improvement from 1995.
-Norwegian fisheries authorities expect to conclude quota negotiations with the Russians today or tomorrow, while negotiations with EU are far more complicated.
-Norwegian shipping group Fredriksen will probably win a Texaco contract for oil production at the Galley field in the North Sea.
-Chief economists Harald Magnus Andreassen at Elcon Securities recommends that the authorities keep the crown stable. If not he fears serious problems for industry.
